name: replicate
description: Discover and run thousands of open AI models on Replicate, and deploy your own with Cog.

interface.shortDescription: Run image, video, audio, and language models with one API.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to Replicate's official hosted MCP server (mcp.replicate.com) so the agent can search, compare, and run thousands of models: FLUX and Seedream for images, Veo and Wan for video, plus audio models and open LLMs. Skills cover the predictions API (sync with Prefer: wait, polling, streaming, file inputs and outputs), model selection across the catalog, API token setup, and production deployments including packaging custom models with Cog.
defaultPrompt: Generate four product photo variations with FLUX 1.1 Pro
Which video model on Replicate fits a 10 second ad clip, and what will it cost?
Set up a deployment for my custom model with autoscaling
